instruction: Remove expired payment cards from all my app accounts that have payment cards.
notes: The apps with payment cards are amazon, spotify and venmo (the evaluation only inspects those PaymentCard tables), so phone/gmail/etc. are not involved. Each app is handled by login -> show_payment_cards (asserts cards-listed) -> delete_payment_card, guarded by card-of/expired so only that app's expired cards can be deleted and valid cards are never touched (no added/updated records). Expiry is judged against the given current datetime 2023-05-18, so no date lookup API is needed. The model uses one abstract expired-card placeholder per app; at runtime the delete action is instantiated once per expired card returned by show_payment_cards (the reference solution's 12 calls imply 4 expired cards across the three apps, i.e. one app has two). supervisor-complete-task carries the three deleted expired-card records as non-API parameters so its precondition can express the goal conditions without naming problem objects in the domain; it takes no API arguments since the task asks no question.
